contexts.text: The reason the Lord said Simon son of Jona ()... is that Simon son of Jona = truth from good, or faith from charity.
A dove, which is meant by Jona, = spiritual good... Hence by Simon son of Jona is signified the truth of good, or truth from good.
The faith which is the affection of truth is signified by Peter when he is called Simon son of Jona. Illustrated... By the son of Jona is signified truth from good...
Jona, in the Hebrew language, means a dove, which in the spiritual sense = the good of charity; and the son of Jona, the truth of that good, or the faith of charity.
Simon of Jona = faith from charity... Jona means a dove, by which is signified charity.
